About Me

I am a Systems Software Engineer specializing in AI Infrastructure, DPU(SmartNIC), and Storage Systems. I bridge the gap between rapidly evolving hardware capabilities (GPUs, DPUs, NVMe) and software infrastructure for AI and Data-Intensive applications.

Currently, I am a Software Engineer at MangoBoost, where I lead cross-functional projects to productize research-grade technologies. My work focuses on offloading storage/network I/O to DPUs and accelerating AI workloads through HW/SW co-design.

I received my Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering from KAIST, where I researched Distributed Deep Learning, multi-tenant GPU cluster, Graph Neural Networks and High-Performance Networking.

Projects

Industry Projects @ MangoBoost

DPU-based Storage & AI Acceleration

Led the development and productization of storage offloading on DPU (ARM SoC + FPGA) and AI accelaration.

  • NVMe-oF (TCP) Initiator Offload: Developed SW/HW co-design architecture utilizing SPDK on ARM cores. Achieved line-rate performance and commercialized the solution.
  • AI Storage Acceleration: Developed Direct Data Path technology (equivalent to NVIDIA GDS) connecting Storage/DPU to Host GPUs. Integrated with vLLM, DeepSpeed, and lmcache to maximize AI inference/training throughput.
  • DPU-accelerated Storage Appliance: Spearheaded the architecture of a high-performance and cost-efficient storage appliance powered by DPU acceleration.

Host-DPU In-Band Interconnect

Developed a proprietary in-band management solution using virtio over PCIe.

  • Eliminated the need for external physical cables by implementing virtual Ethernet and Serial Console interfaces.
  • Designed a whole system and Developed software stack including Linux kernel modules and user-space utilities.

Research Projects

IO-TCP (SmartNIC Networking Stack)

Rearchitected the TCP stack to offload I/O operations to SmartNICs (BlueField-2). Decoupled Control/Data planes to achieve line rate throughput on a single core.

CoDDL (Elastic AI Infrastructure)

Built a distributed training framework supporting seamless scale-out/in. Improved cluster efficiency by 3.1x via custom MPI/NCCL scheduling.

Large-Scale GNN Training Optimization

Addressed memory/bandwidth bottlenecks in training billion-scale graphs.

  • Proposed a locality-aware partial execution strategy, offloading aggregation tasks to the CPU to mitigate PCIe bottlenecks.
  • Optimized load balancing between CPU and GPU, achieving up to 6.6x speedup in training throughput.

CaveBat: Privacy-Preserving GNN Inference

Designed a secure recommender system enabling inference on private data without leakage.

  • Developed SERS (Secure Referencing of Private Server Data) protocol using Homomorphic Encryption and PIR.
  • Implemented reference count obfuscation and partial reuse techniques, improving efficiency by 3.1x.
